business.what_it_does: An AI support platform that automates customer conversations, collects and prioritizes feedback, and helps companies improve their product based on what customers need.
business.category: Customer support platform, feedback management, help desk automation
business.business_model: Subscription per seat, plus usage-based charges for AI resolutions and outbound email volume beyond free tier

segments.name: Product managers at scaling software companies
segments.situation: Customer feedback arrives through support and sales intermediaries rather than directly from customers. Requests get lost in Jira, duplicates are hard to identify, and sales and support have no visibility into what is planned or shipped.

situation_provenance.quote: We used Jira which is totally not built for capturing feature requests. Our internal team had to submit requests on behalf of customers, which created so many bottlenecks and blind spots.
You basically had a layer between you and customers. Things got lost, it was difficult to identify duplicates, and hard to prioritize.

segments.job_to_be_done: Collect feedback directly from customers, deduplicate requests, surface them to the product team, and show customers what is planned and shipped
segments.trigger: Taking on a Product Manager or Head of Product role where feedback management becomes a bottleneck across departments

segments.name: Support team leaders growing beyond one person
segments.situation: As support volume grows, managing customer conversations across email and chat becomes harder without a shared inbox, workflows for routing, or AI assistance to speed up replies.
segments.job_to_be_done: Route, track, and respond to customer issues across channels faster, with AI-powered reply suggestions and workflow automation
segments.trigger: Hiring a second support person or transitioning from ad-hoc email to formal ticketing

pains.statement: Managing high conversation volume without a shared inbox leads to missed replies and slow response times
Repetitive support responses take time away from complex customer issues
